title: The Future of War, and How It Affects YOU (Multi-Domain Operations) - Smarter Every Day 211
summary: Destin Sandlin of Smarter Every Day explains Multi-Domain Operations through footage from his last mission at RIMPAC 2018. He covers missile and torpedo testing and interviews military leaders about the cyber and information domains.
why: HN cites it for an insider's look at defense work and at how the military thinks about information operations and cyberspace.

quote.text: It's an insightful how-and-why explanation for those wondering why there aren't more conscientious objectors
